comparison.objective: Dry an upright pane with overlapping squeegee strokes; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires maintaining blade angle and normal force through long strokes plus wiping between strokes. Candidate requires fine rotary adjustment and lock manipulation followed by impact trials.
comparison.success_condition: Record scores dry-cell coverage, 2 N pressure, 30–60 degree angle and absence of streaking. Candidate scores repeatable non-bottoming stops; some failure thresholds are undeclared.
comparison.reason: Contact-rich surface coverage and fluid-proxy management test a different capability from damper commissioning.
